## Decision models: train Kev and Clef as a whole model
- **`astronomical decision train --whole-model` now trains Kev and Clef as well as Laya.** Small add-on weights in every layer learn together with the final layers, so the model can pick up what it did not notice before. In a test where a code at the start of each text decided the answer, Kev went from 53% to 100% right on questions it never saw, where training only its final layers did not learn it at all. - **Faster whole-model training.** Questions now share each pass through the model. Kev 0.8B trains 200 questions in about two minutes; Clef 9B takes about 40 minutes on a 48 GB Mac. Training sizes its batches to your Mac's memory. - **200 labelled questions are enough** for whole-model training, about 30 or more different texts, the same as for the final layers (it was 1,000). - **A safer `--output`.** `decision train` and `decision calibrate` now check the output folder before reading any example. If Astronomical would not find a model there, they stop at once and name the folders it does look in. A finished training never deletes its own result.
Your existing configuration and trained models keep working as before.
This release is signed with Astronomical's Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed update feed.
